data: analytic synthetic heat-equation and synthetic graph data only; no patient or cohort data

pinn.task: 2D no-flux heat equation with analytic non-negative solution
pinn.objective: data MSE + 0.1 PDE residual MSE + 0.5 initial-condition MSE + 0.2 Neumann-boundary derivative MSE
pinn.interpretation: Boundary- and initial-condition-aware training reduces held-out field error and improves constraint diagnostics, but residuals are nonzero and require further numerical analysis. Synthetic PDE only.

fno.task: 2D periodic heat semigroup with exact Fourier solution
fno.interpretation: Accurately approximates the specified fixed synthetic periodic diffusion operator versus a no-diffusion baseline; cross-resolution and out-of-distribution generalization remain untested.

gnn.task: Predict synthetic local immune-label neighbour fraction
gnn.interpretation: Learns an engineered geometric neighbour statistic on disjoint synthetic graphs; not immune infiltration or a biological cell-interaction model.

limitations: All training and evaluation tasks are analytic or synthetic; none use breast-cancer patient data.
PINN has measurable nonzero PDE and Neumann boundary residuals.
FNO was tested only on 16 by 16 periodic heat operators.
GNN target is a synthetic geometric statistic.
None of these benchmarks validates tumour dynamics, immune escape, treatment response or clinical outcomes.
